facts.text: Averett lowered tuition by nearly $15,000 to under $25,000 per year, pairing it with a single fee covering campus technology, parking, and health services.

sources.title: Tuition & Fees - Averett Admissions
sources.quote: We've reduced our tuition by nearly $15,000 to under $25,000/year! Plus, one simple, comprehensive fee covers all the essentials – technology, activities, health services, parking, and more.
